az_spread: *** WORST SPREAD SINCE GH #252 LANDED: 4 requested across 4 distinct AZs, 4 obtained, but only TWO DISTINCT AZs realized -- us-west-2c x3 and us-west-2d x1. THREE InsufficientInstanceCapacity refusals (2a once, 2b twice) drove two machines through `re-aiming inside the ring` and both landed on the SAME AZ, 2c, which is also where the machine that requested 2c went. GH #252's acceptance (>=2 distinct AZs) passes; GH #256's stricter one (4 distinct, no re-aiming) does NOT. Zero `AZ RING EXHAUSTED`, zero steps down the market ladder, all four spot. *** THE MECHANISM, which is worth more than the count: the ring walk is DETERMINISTIC and single-directional (a->b->c->d). Under region-wide capacity pressure every re-aimed call therefore converges on the same first-available AZ, so the placement decorrelation GH #252 bought is undone exactly in the regime it was bought for. #256 already found the one-hop version of this (a fallback landing on a just-cleared AZ); this is the multi-hop version, and it concentrated 3 of 4 machines. *** EXPOSURE, stated because the carrier gate makes it concrete: every carrier term sits at EXACTLY 2, and the three 2c machines carry crystal_maiden, lion, obsidian_destroyer, skeleton_king, spirit_breaker and zuus between them -- a single 2c capacity event would drop FIVE of the six terms to <=1 and obsidian_destroyer to 0.
